thread:
emma: Heads-up: Finance needs a normalized hw pricing feed from partners that includes spot time-series samples and the precise credit rules for evictions. We want to avoid follow-ups. Can we draft a single ask?

rory: Good call. Key must-haves: guaranteed capacity pct for reserved SKUs, the penalty if they release reserved early, and whether credits are auto-applied or require claim.

juan: Also ask for spot percentiles (p10/p50/p90) rather than just mean/stddev — that'll help tail-case sims. If they have raw time series (timestamp, price_usd) for last 14 days that's ideal.

anika: Legal will want the "proof" they use for credits (logs, eviction event IDs). Request sample evidence format and whether they will redact customer IDs.

claire: Suggested CSV spec (minimal + a few extra for modeling):```
sku_id,vendor,region,instance_sku,gpu_model,vcpu,memory_gb,reserved_hourly_usd,reserved_commit_months,reserved_capacity_guaranteed_pct,reserved_early_release_penalty_usd_per_month,can_release_reserve_early,price_hour_spot,spot_p10_usd,spot_p50_usd,spot_p90_usd,spot_time_series_link,eviction_rate_pct_per_day,eviction_notice_seconds,eviction_credit_type,eviction_credit_value,eviction_min_running_seconds_for_credit,marketplace_listing_fee_pct,marketplace_processing_fee_usd,billing_granularity_seconds,timezone,availability_windows,notes
```

claire: Explanation of a few fields: eviction_credit_type = {hourly_credit, monthly_rebate, invoice_adjustment}; eviction_credit_value = numeric (pct or USD depending on type); availability_windows = comma-separated e.g. "24x7" or "09:00-17:00 PST (Mon-Fri)".

emma: Nice. Please include an example row we can paste into partner outreach.

juan: Example row:```
sku-abc-001, NimbusCloud, eu-central-1, nimbus-p100-48, P100-48GB, 48, 384, 8.50, 6, 90, 12000, true, 2.75, 1.1, 2.6, 6.5, https://s3.example.com/nimbus/spot_series_2026-03.csv, 0.65, 180, hourly_credit, 25, 300, 2.5, 1.00, 60, CET, 09:00-18:00 CET (Mon-Fri), "reserved backed by SLA; credit applies if VM ran >5min; example proofs available"
```

anika: For the credit proofs please ask partners to include a sample JSON schema for an eviction event (timestamp, instance_id, eviction_id, preempt_reason, notice_seconds). That helps our reconciliation pipeline.

rory: Ops asks: include billing_granularity_seconds (60 vs 3600) and whether they round up partial hours. That materially affects hourly cost.

claire: Partner friendly note: If you cannot provide exact eviction_rate_pct, send one of {low/medium/high} with an explanation of how you measured it. For time-series, 7 days is minimum; 14 preferred. If they provide only percentiles, that's OK.

partner-bot: Upload: partner_uploads/templates/hw_pricing_time_series_request_2026-03.csv :white_check_mark:

emma: I'll compile responses into the cost model. Please send the outreach copy you plan to use here before sending. Also we'll gate any partner listing updates on having at least 7 days of spot history + stated credit rules.

juan: One more ask: include any volume-discount breakpoints and the effective discount at each tier as separate columns (volume_tier_1_units, volume_tier_1_discount_pct...). If too many tiers, attach a separate CSV.

anika: I'll add a short paragraph about what evidentiary artifacts we need for credits so partners know what to expect.

emma: Great. Check-in Thurs 9am to review partials. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
